intro.text: A member of the Kholin army, probably an officer in command of Dalinar's elites.

items.text: Tanalan tricked Dalinar into believing that Sadeas meant to attack him under cover of a caravan. Dalinar had Horinar gather a hundred of his fastest elites to investigate with him, but Tanalan sprang a trap and a landslide fell on Dalinar, killing many of his men. Whether Horinar survived is unknown.
